description: This is a test class for EmpEmergencyContactDao, a Data Access Object responsible for managing employee emergency contact information within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes test methods that validate saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contact records in the database.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing Employee Emergency Contact Data Access Object methods within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmpEmergencyContactDao, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Verifies that an employee emergency contact can be saved and retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an emergency contact with a specific sequence number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Checks that an invalid sequence number raises an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Ensures that the list of emergency contacts for an employee can be retrieved.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a specific emergency contact, including handling of non-existing records.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests the deletion of multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Checks search functionality based on filters like employee number and name.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that search results can be limited to a specific number.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Ensures the count of filtered emergency contacts is accurate.
